overview_description.description:
Letswork is a Dubai-based startup founded in 2018 that provides an on-demand marketplace for workspaces. Through its mobile app and membership plans, users can work from a large network of partner locations including coworking spaces, cafés, and hotels without long-term office leases.

The platform connects professionals to hundreds of workspaces across multiple cities and countries, enabling them to book desks, meeting rooms, private offices, and creative studios whenever needed. It is designed to support remote work and digital nomads by offering flexible plans and instant check-in through the app.

about_short_description.short_description: Letswork is a workspace membership platform that allows remote workers, freelancers, and teams to access flexible workspaces.

product.name: Coworking
product.description: Access to coworking spaces and cafes with membership plans available daily, monthly, or annually, including amenities like WiFi and power outlets.

product.name: Meeting Rooms
product.description: Hourly or daily rental of meeting and event spaces with options for catering, bookable instantly without forms or calls.

product.name: Offices
product.description: Rental of dedicated private workspaces with professional amenities available on daily, monthly, or annual leases, either serviced or standalone.

product.name: Creative Studios
product.description: Rental of creative spaces such as podcast and photography studios available by the hour or day, with technical assistance.
